scope: Independent source/prior-art/value gate for BCL2-family pharmacology; not a new numerical hypothesis or fully blinded team
owner: clinical_measurements/apoptosis_source_challenge only; wider source owner fapi_broader, protein context owner radiotherapy
question: Do authentic native EMC screens contain chemically and exposure-compatible BCL2-selective versus BCL2/BCL-xL or MCL1 comparisons that could provide a useful unanswered empirical phenotype beyond published BCL2 IHC and screen conclusions?
before_new_measurements: First inspect original method identity, complete compound names/CAS, dose-duration/readout/probe controls and provenance of known prior evaluations. Do not inspect new drug outcome fields or molecular measurements until one exact useful comparison/units/controls/priorart/alternatives/disproof is frozen and root reviews. Verified prior outcomes may be reused; no claim of full-team blinding.
canonical_identity_correction: Bangerter40screen uses USZ20-EMC1; Iwata221screen+24IC50 uses NCC-EMC1-C1. Root earlier shorthand USZ22/disputed was not a source fact. USZ22/USZ23 and H-EMC-SS distinct and possible donor/lineage aliases must be source-authenticated, not independently counted.
source_relevance: All authentic EMC models/specimens/conditions, assay controls/technicalreplicates and prior drug/IHC evidence; chemistry aliases/salt forms cannot be equated without mapping. No favorable compound subset or broad replacement panel.
scientific_use_required: Could justify a specific matched-exposure orthogonal apoptosis experiment only if actual assays and prior art leave a useful clinically/biologically relevant contrast. ATP viability/IC50 cannot prove protein dependence, apoptosis or clinical benefit.
strongest_alternatives: Compound names, salts or multitarget/off-target activity misassigned to family selectivity
Duration/dose/bound drug availability/doubling time/readout differences masquerade as differential susceptibility
Outcome-selected IC50 subset or ordinal category lacks compatible continuous comparative information
Models share donors/aliases or culture selection, not independent validation
BCL2 diagnostic IHC positivity is already known and does not establish target addiction
Comparison duplicates source paper conclusions without a useful addition
defeat_stop: No distinct selective comparators at compatible exposures/assay conditions, missing authentic native model or control maps, or priorart removes useful novelty means scoped no-go before numerical stage. Do not rescue with RNA, a replacement panel or mechanistic/dependency assertions.
restrictions: Denied FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA/private-login/bypass closed; no paid/GPU/outreach/publication/PR/shared-root changes/push. Original sources ignored/read-only reuse; compact evaluated records exported. Quiet API/files; check clock before UI during06–10America/New_York.
